name: Power Systems: Gridmere
subtitle: Power Systems Grid Labs
shortDescription: Adaptive power systems course in five cited 3D benches: trip a line, tune a long line, fix power factor, clear a fault. Study aid only.
longDescription:
Power Systems: Gridmere is an offline study app for a first power systems course. Every lesson starts with a real problem and lets you move the grid yourself.

FIVE 3D BENCHES
- Grid mesh: trip a line on a three-bus city grid and watch the power reroute.
- Long line: slide the load along a 400 km transmission line and see the voltage ribbon rise or sag.
- Factory power factor: switch in capacitor stages and watch the power triangle shrink.
- Fault laboratory: choose a fault type and see the sequence networks link as three stacked layers.
- Swing rotor: change the clearing time and see whether the rotor swings back or slips.
Every bench shows a second method computed on the spot, so you can see two independent calculations agree.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
Pick 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number of questions and a level from beginner to research. Missed topics come back sooner. A mock exam uses numeric problems only, with an optional timer and no ads.

CITED AND HONEST
Sources open in a window inside the app: textbooks and the MIT OpenCourseWare course page, linked and never copied. Gridmere is for study only, never for real design, protection settings or electrical safety decisions.

FREE WITH OPTIONAL AD REMOVAL
Free with ads at natural breaks. Watch one ad for 30 minutes without ads, or subscribe monthly to remove ads . No account, and your progress stays on your device.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
